title: Lithospermic acid improves liver fibrosis through Piezo1-mediated oxidative stress and inflammation.
authors: Luo, Shangfei; Yang, Bo; Xu, Honglin; Pan, Xianmei; Chen, Xin; Jue, Xiaoyu; Liu, Silin; Wan, Rentao; Tan, Qiaorui; Yao, Youfen; Chen, Xiaoting; Jiang, Jintao; Deng, Bo; Li, Jing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究紫草酸通过Piezo1介导的氧化应激和炎症改善肝纤维化，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatic fibrosis is becoming an increasingly serious public health issue worldwide. Although liver transplantation is the only and definitive treatment for end-stage liver fibrosis, traditional Chinese medicine offers certain benefits in the treatment of advanced hepatic fibrosis. PURPOSE: This study aims to explore the protective effect of lithospermic acid (LA), an extraction from Salvia miltiorrhiza (the roots of S. miltiorrhiza Bunge, known as Danshen in Chinese), on liver fibrosis and investigate its potential mechanisms. METHODS AND RESULTS: Mice were treated with carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4)) via intraperitoneal injection for 4 weeks. LA was orally administered or colchicine (COL) was injected intraperitoneally for 3 weeks starting one week after the initial CCl(4) injection. After the LA treatment, we observed a decrease in the fibrosis index and an improvement in liver function. Molecular docking results revealed that Piezo1 may be a potential pharmacological target of LA. The further experimental results showed that LA inhibited Piezo1 activation and expression in macrophages. Mechanistically, both Piezo1/Notch-mediated inflammation and oxidative stress regulated by the Piezo1/Ca(2+) pathway were alleviated in fibrotic livers following LA treatment. Moreover, less oxidative stress and Notch activation were observed in the deficiency of macrophage Piezo1 (Piezo1(DeltaLysM)) mice. In addition, Piezo1(DeltaLysM) partially counteracted the pharmacological effects of LA on liver fibrosis. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, our present study corroborated LA limits the progression of liver fibrosis by regulating Piezo1-mediated oxidative stress and inflammation. These results indicate that LA could be a potential medication for hepatic fibrosis treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝纤维化正日益成为全球范围内一个严重的公共卫生问题。尽管肝移植是终末期肝纤维化的唯一且根治性治疗方法，但传统中药在晚期肝纤维化的治疗中展现出一定优势。目的：本研究旨在探讨紫草酸（lithospermic acid, LA）——一种从丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza，即丹参的根部，中文称为丹参）中提取的成分——对肝纤维化的保护作用，并研究其潜在机制。方法与结果：小鼠通过腹腔注射四氯化碳（CCl(4)）处理4周。在首次CCl(4)注射一周后，开始口服LA或腹腔注射秋水仙碱（colchicine, COL），持续3周。LA处理后，我们观察到纤维化指数下降和肝功能改善。分子对接结果显示，Piezo1可能是LA的潜在药理靶点。进一步的实验结果表明，LA抑制了巨噬细胞中Piezo1的激活和表达。机制上，在LA处理后的纤维化肝脏中，由Piezo1/Notch介导的炎症和由Piezo1/Ca(2+)通路调控的氧化应激均得到缓解。此外，在巨噬细胞Piezo1缺陷（Piezo1(DeltaLysM)）小鼠中，观察到较少的氧化应激和Notch激活。另外，Piezo1(DeltaLysM)部分抵消了LA对肝纤维化的药理作用。结论：总之，本研究证实LA通过调控Piezo1介导的氧化应激和炎症来限制肝纤维化的进展。这些结果表明，LA可能成为治疗肝纤维化的潜在药物。
